method: Built-in image generation tool; image references and targeted edits
style: Use case: illustration-story. ONE standalone Marrowdeep game cutscene bitmap. Attached image is STYLE reference ONLY. STRICT COARSE PIXEL ART: looks drawn at just 160 pixels across then enlarged 10 TIMES nearest-neighbor. Every edge and internal mark uses same BIG visible square pixel grid, prominent square staircase contours, primitive economical block shapes. Face at most 12 pixels across; eyes 1-2 square blocks, no wrinkle lines or fine features. No small details within pixels. Black and bone-white FLAT colors ONLY; saturated blood-red ONLY if scene asks. Sparse large checkerboard dither clusters. Heavy raw black shapes, broken white pixel highlights. Absolutely no smooth ink, fine lines, hatching, gradients, glossy textures, antialiasing, photorealism, polished anime illustration, tiny detail, text/bubbles/border unless exact block lettering specified. Original characters, no recognizable manga character likeness. ONLY IF the scene explicitly includes the sellsword: deep hood hides almost all face, no spiky hair, no broad heroic jaw, plain normal longsword. Do not add a sellsword to other scenes. Render ONLY objects and people specified in the scene. Essential content central 70%, quiet areas top and bottom for engine overlays.
